syncSegmentsEn.text: Abide in Me, for I am your mighty God
The God who rescues and keeps you in every trial and sorrow
Do not fear or tremble, for I will reach out My hand to help you
Do not be afraid, for I will take hold of your hand
While you were in the womb I called you by name and chose you. You are Mine, you are Mine…
I am your mighty God
I will treasure you as My dearly honored child
I am the God who loves you, the Lord your God
